breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The ground truth correctly identifies that the Reynolds number will be in the turbulent regime and provides the appropriate turbulent correlation (δ ≈ 0.37 x Re_x^{-1/5}). The agent, however, repeated the user's incorrect instruction to use the laminar correlation (δ = 5x/√(Re_x)). While it added a step to verify the laminar assumption, it did not correct the fundamental error of using the wrong formula for the given physical conditions.
